title: Rolling, shifting and windows for a series over time

videos.script: How many trips yesterday? More than the day before? {{yesterday}} More than the same day last week? {{week}} And what about the last seven days, taken together? {{seven}} Every series over time gets these questions. {{questions}} pandas answers them with three tools. shift moves the values along the calendar. rolling slides a window. resample cuts the year into weeks or months. {{tools}} They are short to write. The trouble is in the data. {{trouble}} A quiet station has days with no trips, and a count made with groupby leaves those days out. {{quiet}} Then a window of seven rows is not seven days, and the average is too high. Nothing warns you. {{high}} So the lesson ends with a rule. Before any window, make sure every day has a row. And decide what an empty day means. {{end}}
